descriptionChirho: A crossing point in terrain, whether a ford across a river or a mountain pass; ford, passage, crossing. Used of the fords of the Jordan where Ehud's men seized the crossings against Moab (Judg 3:28; 12:5-6), the Jordan fords near Jericho (Josh 2:7), the fords of the Arnon (Isa 16:2), the passages/fords of Babylon (Jer 51:32), a mountain pass at Michmash (1 Sam 14:4), and the pass at Aiath (Isa 10:29). The singular (ma'barah) and plural (ma'berot/ma'barot) forms all denote the same basic concept of a traversable crossing point in the landscape.
